characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: Askeladden is a young man with an average build and unkempt dark hair that suggests a humble background. His clothing is simple and rustic, often showing signs of wear. He is often seen with a large wooden kneading trough, which he treasures and carries on his journeys. Askeladden is depicted as having a curious and earnest face, reflecting his determination and cleverness. Despite his humble origins, he exudes a sense of resourcefulness and optimism.

characters.name: Troldet
characters.description: Troldet, the troll, is an imposing figure with a massive build, covered in rugged, rocky skin. He has wild, disheveled hair and large, fierce eyes that reflect his volatile nature. His presence is often associated with darkness and danger, living in a forbidding cave on the opposite side of the lake from the royal palace. He is protective of his treasures, including the seven silver ducks, a magnificent bedspread, and a golden harp.

characters.name: Trolddatteren
characters.description: Trolddatteren is depicted with features similar to her father but slightly more refined, indicating her youth. She has wild hair and sharp, inquisitive eyes. Her attire is primitive, made from natural elements. She is initially loyal to her father's wishes, but her character is ultimately outwitted by Askeladden's cunning.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: Kongen is a regal figure, appearing mature and dignified, with a commanding presence. He wears opulent robes and a crown, epitomizing his royal status. His expression often shows a mix of authority and curiosity, particularly towards Askeladden's feats. As he grows fond of Askeladden's ingenuity, his demeanor becomes warmer.

characters.name: Prinsessen
characters.description: Prinsessen is portrayed as a young and beautiful woman with flowing hair and a kind, gentle expression. She wears elegant royal attire with fine details that signify her high status. Her presence in the scenes is one of grace and poise, often displaying curiosity and admiration for Askeladden's bravery and cleverness.
